frequency_question: How often do announced central bank liquidity ratio implementations formally meet all specified naming, instrument type, and date window criteria?
membership_rule: Members are central bank policy announcements introducing temporary or incremental reserve ratio requirements. Excluded are standard permanent reserve ratio changes or open market operations.

cases.name: RBI incremental CRR guidelines historical equivalent

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 2 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 2 named; all known matching instances successfully met the exact formal notification criteria.
known_gaps: Small sample size for this specific named instrument subset, but high compliance across broader central bank announcements.
skeleton: Total similar liquidity tool announcements matching exact nomenclature and timing constraints divided by total policy intent implementations.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 2 relevant historical implementations of targeted liquidity instruments meeting strict criteria.
validity_reason: Central bank regulatory notification standards change slowly over multi-year periods.
